meta.title: A Stock Split Sounds Like a Discount. It Isn't.
meta.hook: A stock split can make a $900 share suddenly cost $90. Your money hasn't changed at all.
meta.description: A stock split multiplies a company's share count while dividing the price by the same factor — total value is unchanged. Companies split mainly to make shares look more accessible to smaller investors, not to create new value. Educational content only, not financial advice.

scenes.narration: A stock split can turn a nine hundred dollar share into ten shares worth ninety dollars each.

visual.query: stock chart screen numbers close up
visual.visual_intent: A glowing stock price ticker splitting visually into smaller numbered blocks, dark cinematic finance screen
visual.decision_reason: hook beat: the visual math, hard cut

scenes.narration: It feels like a discount. It isn't. Nothing about the company changed.

visual.visual_intent: A quiet trading floor with idle screens, stillness after the opening rush, cool light

scenes.narration: A split just multiplies the number of shares while dividing the price by the same factor.

visual.query: pie chart splitting into equal pieces animation style footage
visual.visual_intent: A whole shape dividing into equal smaller pieces, clean graphic-style motion, dark background
visual.decision_reason: core mechanics, definitional — no company-specific figure asserted

scenes.narration: If you owned one share worth nine hundred dollars, you now own ten shares worth ninety. Same total value.

visual.query: stack of coins dividing into smaller stacks
visual.visual_intent: One tall stack of coins splitting into ten smaller equal stacks on a dark surface, macro
visual.decision_reason: illustrates value conservation with a worked example

scenes.narration: So why do companies bother? Mostly optics. A lower share price looks more accessible to smaller investors.

visual.query: young investor looking at phone stock app
visual.visual_intent: A person checking a stock app on their phone, casual setting, natural light

scenes.narration: It can also make options and small trades easier to size. But your ownership stake never grows from a split alone.

visual.query: hands typing on trading computer screen
visual.visual_intent: Hands typing at a desk with a trading screen in soft focus behind, warm light

scenes.narration: The math doesn't create a cent of new wealth. It just cuts the same pie into smaller slices.

visual.query: whole pie cut into slices on table overhead
visual.visual_intent: An overhead shot of a whole pie being cut into equal slices, clean warm light
